tools.description: Show the menu for a merchant/restaurant by merchant_id (from a `search` result). The result includes the menu's `categories` (sections); pass a `categoryId` to browse that section's items (paged via `page`, with `has_more`). Omit both to show the top items; provide `query` to search within the menu.

tools.name: get_full_menu
tools.description: Fetch the entire menu of a merchant in one call — all categories and all items. Use this when the user wants to browse the full menu, or when you need to find an item across all sections without paging. Returns every category with its products. Capped at 250 items total; if truncated, use search_mer

tools.description: Show full details for a single product/menu item by product_id (obtain it from a `search_merchant_products` result). tools.name: get_top_searches
tools.description: Return the platform's currently trending / most-searched terms. Useful for suggesting what users can look for. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Return whether the customer is signed in for this session, and who.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Sign the customer out of this session (clears the stored token).

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in customer's profile (name, phone, email, language, loyalty tier, total orders, member-since). Requires the customer to be signed in for this session. Read-only.

tools.name: get_addresses
tools.description: Return the signed-in customer's saved delivery addresses (title, details, type, coordinates). Requires the customer to be signed in for this session. Read-only.

tools.name: get_order_history
tools.description: Return the signed-in customer's orders — `current` (in-progress) and `history` (past), each with merchant, status, total, item count and date. Requires the customer to be signed in for this session. Read-only.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Track a Lezzoo order live — status, ETA, driver name/status/location, merchant, destination, and the ordered items (name, description, quantity, price, chosen options, image) — rendered as a status card with a progress stepper (and a map when the driver's live position is available). Pass an order_i

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Show the current shopping cart (items, options, quantities, line prices, subtotal). Anonymous — no sign-in required. Read-only.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add one or more products to the cart in a single call (put a whole request's items in one call). For several of the SAME item use `quantity` (e.g. "2 Chili Boxes" → quantity: 2). For DIFFERENT products use `items` (an array of { productId, quantity?, optionValueIds? }), each with its own `quantity`.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set the quantity of a cart line by line_id (from view_cart). Quantity 0 removes it.

tools.name: remove_cart_item
tools.description: Remove a cart line by line_id (from view_cart).

tools.name: clear_cart
tools.description: Remove all items from the cart.

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: List the available DIGITAL payment methods for checkout (e.g. Lezzoo Pay wallet, FIB, Card, Asia Pay, FastPay, Qi Card, NassWallet). Cash on delivery is NOT supported. Requires sign-in. Use this to map a payment method the user names to its payment_type_id.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Get the current Lezzoo Pay (wallet) balance for the signed-in customer. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: review_order
tools.description: Prices the current cart for checkout (delivery, discount, fees, total) and renders an interactive widget in which the user selects their delivery address and payment method as tappable options — those details are chosen in the widget rather than in chat. tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place the order from the current cart. Call review_order first so the customer can confirm the total. Set confirm:true to actually place the order — without it, this returns a preview only. Requires sign-in and a non-empty cart.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: Generate a payment link for a placed order. Use this if the payment link expired or was not returned at order placement. Requires sign-in.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, review_order · Private data: logout, get_payment_methods, get_wallet_balance · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: remove_cart_item, clear_cart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, review_order · Private data: logout, get_payment_methods, get_wallet_balance · Public sink: get_profile · Destructive: remove_cart_item, clear_cart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
